deadlines.label: UCAS deadline for 2027 entry to Cambridge
deadlines.notes: 18:00 UK time. All Cambridge courses use the 15 October deadline; Cambridge sets its own admissions assessment (TMUA / ESAT) and interviews.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Applies if you are not from a majority English speaking country as defined by the UK Home Office. The offering College decides the condition, which may be based on a high school qualification grade or an approved test; a school-leaving qualification demonstrating C1 or above can be enough.

english.notes: IELTS Academic, normally 7.5 overall, usually 7.0 or above in each element. Recommended at application for interview: 6.5 overall, no element below 6.0.
C2 Proficiency: minimum overall 200, no element lower than 185. C1 Advanced is accepted at overall 193, no element lower than 185, alongside other evidence of competence in English.

tier_notes.general: Complete University Guide 2027 overall ranking: 1st of 130 UK universities (S = ranks 1-5 on the national scale).
